holdings.name: Pine Labs Ltd.

what_changed.text: NPCI deferred the rollout of MDR on UPI beyond Diwali, causing payment stocks including Pine Labs to fluctuate sharply before recovering.
The company partnered with Google Cloud for agentic commerce and announced plans to deploy 10 lakh soundboxes across India.
Pine Labs extended its five-year technology partnership with Woolworths Group for gift card platform support.

holdings.why_it_matters: Pine Labs is the largest position in the fund at 2.82% weight, providing a +0.219% contribution over 3 months despite recent 1-month volatility of -11.13%.

watch.text: Regulatory progress on UPI MDR implementation from NPCI.
Execution of the 10 lakh soundbox rollout across India.

holdings.name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd

what_changed.text: Promoter group entities sold 40 lakh shares in the open market on September 29-30, 2026, lowering promoter stake to 45.79%.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 24, 2026 to review Q2 FY27 financial results and consider an interim dividend.

expected.text: Management expects volume recovery and steady margins driven by stronger demand.

holdings.why_it_matters: Kajaria Ceramics is the fund's second largest holding at 2.43% weight, anchoring the fund's 23.1% Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings performance and interim dividend consideration on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: Equitas Small Finance Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: A GST demand against the bank was reduced from ₹534 crore down to ₹24 crore.
CARE reaffirmed the bank's CARE AA- Stable issuer and Tier II ratings, as well as CARE A1+ for ₹1,500 crore CDs.

expected.text: The bank indicated it may raise its FY27 loan growth guidance above 25% with limited expected impact from Maharashtra drought conditions.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.32% portfolio weight, the stock dropped -9.46% over 3 months, acting as a drag within the 17.7% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 results and management guidance revision during the earnings call on October 29, 2026.

holdings.name: Eris Lifesciences Ltd

what_changed.text: Executive Director and COO Krishnakumar Vaidyanathan resigned effective September 30, 2026, while Chirag Mehta was appointed as Executive Director.
Akhil Awasthi joined the board as an Independent Director.

holdings.why_it_matters: Eris Lifesciences is the fund's top negative contributor over the 3-month period, reducing fund performance by -0.427% due to a -21.37% return at a 2.0% portfolio weight.

watch.text: Operational stability following senior leadership and COO changes.

holdings.name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd

what_changed.text: Brigade Group announced plans for a 40 million sq ft expansion involving ₹40,000 crore in capital investment and is evaluating a REIT structure.
Real estate shares including Brigade declined following an RBI interest rate hike.

expected.text: Management aims for a 21% increase in FY27 pre-sales supported by housing demand.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.0% of the fund, Brigade constitutes the vast majority of the portfolio's 3.3% Real Estate sector allocation.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 financial performance and pre-sales updates on October 29-30, 2026.

holdings.name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: Metropolis released a Q2 FY27 business update reporting approximately 15% year-on-year revenue growth and improved operating margins.
CRISIL reaffirmed the company's AA- credit rating and revised its outlook to positive.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holds a 1.91% weight in the portfolio, representing almost a fifth of the fund's 10% Healthcare allocation.

watch.text: Audited confirmation of margins and revenue in the full Q2 FY27 financial release.

holdings.name: Angel One Ltd

what_changed.text: Angel One reported Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 58.2% to ₹335 crore on 18.9% revenue growth and declared a dividend.
Capital market stocks including Angel One fell over 3% following SEBI's changes to Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) rules.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.87% weight, the stock detracted from 3-month performance (-8.8%) due to regulatory changes despite reported earnings growth.

watch.text: Trading volume and client addition trends under the updated SEBI CAS regulations.

holdings.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd

what_changed.text: HAL agreed to acquire CAE Canada's 50% stake in HATSOFF for nil consideration to make it a wholly owned subsidiary within 60 days.
The company approached delivery of its 2,000th aero-engine, supported by a new Shakti line.
Anindya Biswas was appointed as Government Nominee Director and Dr. Nikhil Agarwal as Independent Director.

holdings.why_it_matters: HAL delivered a +10.85% return over 3 months, contributing +0.201% to the fund within its top-weighted sector, Industrials.

watch.text: Finalization of the HATSOFF acquisition within the 60-day window.

holdings.name: PNB Housing Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: CRISIL upgraded PNB Housing Finance to AAA/Stable, meaning the company is now rated AAA across all four major credit rating agencies.

expected.text: Management expects a 5-8 basis point gain in net interest margin (NIM) resulting from the RBI interest rate hike.

holdings.why_it_matters: A 1.85% holding that appreciated 6.17% over 3 months and 26.42% over 6 months, stabilizing the Financials exposure.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings call and NIM expansion results.

holdings.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd

what_changed.text: Subsidiary Deepak Chem Tech commissioned a new chlorination and specialty chemicals plant in Dahej with ₹300 crore capex.
Deepak Chem Tech allotted ₹80 crore worth of OCRPS to Deepak Phenolics.

holdings.why_it_matters: Represents 1.76% of the portfolio and is a key driver of the 9.2% Materials allocation.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 financial results review scheduled for October 29, 2026.

portfolio.statement: Franklin India Small Cap Fund returned -3.59% over 3 months and -2.05% over 1 month, with gains in defense, technology, and housing finance offset by steep drawdowns in healthcare and travel tech holdings.
interp: Top detractors Eris Lifesciences (-21.37%) and Le Travenues Technology (-27.74%) materially eroded 3-month fund returns.
Capital goods, defense, and select tech names such as Syrma SGS, MTAR Technologies, and HAL provided positive return cushions.
portfolio.line: Short-term small-cap weakness driven by sharp healthcare and consumer discretionary pullbacks, partially balanced by industrial momentum.

drivers.text: HAL gained 10.85% over 3 months, supported by engine production milestones and subsidiary consolidation.
Angel One faced regulatory pressure from SEBI's revised CAS rules despite delivering a 58.2% increase in Q2 net profit.
Pine Labs navigated volatility stemming from NPCI's postponement of UPI MDR implementation.
